waypoints.name: Valdez
waypoints.advice: Valdez is where the day begins. Next is Thompson Pass.

waypoints.name: Thompson Pass
waypoints.advice: Thompson Pass comes up 109 km in. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Worthington Glacier, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Worthington Glacier
waypoints.advice: 218 km in you reach Worthington Glacier. Next is Glennallen.

waypoints.name: Glennallen
waypoints.advice: Glennallen closes the day.

sections.advice: Valdez → Thompson Pass climbs about 855 m in 42 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Thompson Pass → Worthington Glacier drops about 855 m over 4 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Worthington Glacier → Glennallen is 131 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

richardson-highway-valdez-glennallen.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Richardson Highway. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Valdez → Thompson Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 77 km. 855 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Richardson Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: 855 m come off over 7 km at around 22.8%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

richardson-highway-valdez-glennallen.story: 327 km from Valdez to the finish, about 4 h 33 of riding. On the way it passes Thompson Pass and Worthington Glacier. The highest point is about 1,200 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
